name: skill_edit
description: Write or replace a skill file (markdown) in the skills/ directory. The next system prompt includes all skill files, so this tool lets you improve your own instructions. Input: {"path": "skills/<name>.md", "content": "..."}. Returns {"ok": true, "path": "..."}.
llm_description: Write/replace a skill markdown file in skills/; included in the next system prompt. {path:'skills/<name>.md', content}.
